706960101.text: Hello there, little one. What a lovely surprise. Where have your travels taken you recently?

706960102.text: You tell Miko about Minnie, the Legion of Soulblazers, and the Dragonspine Cross Country Challenge.

706960103.text: Aww. They all sound quite adorable.

706960104.text: It must have been quite an adventure for them, coming from far and wide, crossing national boundaries to meet with kindred spirits... Ah, it's a tale filled with the romance of youth.

706960105.text: The Soulblazer Saga seems to have quite a strong following. Maybe it's time to run another round of reprints...

706960106.text: With such a dedicated fanbase, it's only right to throw a token of gratitude their way.

706960107.text: How about some free comic books? Hmm... There's quite a large group of you, I'll need to make sure there's enough to go around.

706960110.text: These are first-edition prints — you won't find them for sale anywhere. Take good care of them, now.

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the camp and place the gift

706960201.text: Miko gave us a pretty generous stash of comics. Since the plan is to share them with the group, why don't we display them somewhere that everyone can see?

706960202.text: Let's put them near the book stand at the Legion of Soulblazers' camp. That way, it'll be easy for people to browse.

706960203.text: You borrow a bookcase and arrange the comics from Miko on the shelves.

706960204.text: Nice, it's looking good! Now people can come and pick some out when they're free.
